speaker: Al Sharpton
biography: Al Sharpton is a minister, civil-rights activist, author, and broadcaster. He founded the National Action Network in 1991, and his public work includes nonviolent protest, voting-rights advocacy, and campaigns concerning policing and racial inequality.
sourceIdentityVerification: The National Action Network’s official About page links Rev. Al Sharpton to this organizational biography. The biography describes his ministry, books, broadcasting, founding role, and civil-rights work. CUNY TV independently identifies the same person as National Action Network’s founder.
